      uid=3_36 StaticText "CASE FILE 01 / THE ONES WHO STAYED"
      uid=3_37 heading "NOT EVERY LOCAL IS LIVING." level="2"
      uid=3_38 StaticText "A ghost dog. Unsettling encounters. Locals who may have overstayed their welcome. Hear the stories that give downtown Boulder City its haunted reputation."

      uid=3_46 StaticText "CASE FILE 03 / LOOK UP"
      uid=3_47 heading "SOMETHING IS OUT THERE." level="2"
      uid=3_48 StaticText "Area 51 lore, strange sightings, and unexplained lights. Nevada has plenty of room for a good mystery."
